title: Protesters gather at Oxford University against academic Nathan Cofnas

tea.why: Protesters oppose an event featuring academic Nathan Cofnas, who has been accused of racism and previously targeted the late Professor Jason Arday.
tea.want: The cancellation of the event featuring Nathan Cofnas at Oriel College.
tea.changed: Nov 17: Hundreds of protesters gathered outside Oriel College to oppose the event, with some attempting to block the main gates.

summary: On November 17, 2026, hundreds of demonstrators gathered outside Oriel College at the University of Oxford to protest an event featuring US academic Nathan Cofnas. The event, titled 'Is DEI Undermining Higher Education', was organised by the Oxford Reform student society. Protesters, including those organised by Stand Up To Racism, held placards and chanted slogans against the speaker, who has previously faced controversy for his views on race and for plagiarism allegations made against the late Professor Jason Arday. Demonstrators attempted to block the college's main gates during the rally. While the college stated that hosting the event did not imply an endorsement of the speaker's views, an online petition calling for the invitation to be cancelled had previously gathered over 32,000 signatures.
demands: Cancel Nathan Cofnas's invitation to speak
response: Oriel College stated that hosting the event on its grounds 'does not imply endorsement by the College of the views of its speakers'.

updates.text: Hundreds of protesters gathered at Oriel College to oppose the talk and attempted to block the main gates.
